research_status: 2014-2020 is disclosed iterative Development; 2021-2023 remains unopened until the Development gate passes
economic_hypothesis: A sector-specific bull phase begins when PIT industry return and participation breadth accelerate together over five completed sessions while the broad market is not bearish. During that capital-diffusion window, the first moderate-volume close through a stock's prior 20-session pressure level can be the stock-level transmission of new sector demand, provided the stock was already in a positive but non-euphoric 60-session trend and had no recent limit-up crowding.
independence: No downward collapse-gap, V6/V7/V26 event identity, or gap-repair outcome is used.

binding_conditions.PIT_INDUSTRY_BREADTH_IGNITION: industry20 > 3%, industry breadth20 > 60%, five-session industry20 increase >=3 percentage points, and five-session industry breadth20 increase >=15 percentage points
binding_conditions.POSITIVE_NON_EUPHORIC_STOCK: completed stock ret60 is between 0% and 30%; there was no limit-up close in the prior 20 completed stock sessions
binding_conditions.FIRST_MODERATE_PRESSURE_BREAK: completed close exceeds the prior 20-session high; signal return is +2% to +8%; close location >=70%; turnover is 1.2x-4.0x prior20 mean

event_cooldown: after an accepted signal identity, the same symbol cannot form another signal for 20 market sessions
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
